intro.title: Two steps
points: 1. Read quickly: who is it from? who is it to? what is it about?
2. Read again slowly and find the exact information: times, places, names.

intro.en: Hi Kamila, I'm at the library. Meet me at 4. Jasur
intro.note: from Jasur / to Kamila / where: library / when: 4

intro.title: Decide carefully
points: TRUE = the text says the same thing.
FALSE = the text says the opposite.
NOT GIVEN = the text does not say this. Do not guess!

intro.title: Notes use
points: present continuous for now: I'm doing my homework.
can for requests: Can we have pizza?
imperatives (orders) for instructions: Meet me at 4. Call me.
